qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the reverse gear shaft to case on all manual transmission types?
What torque should be applied to the reverse gear shaft to case on S 5 D 310 Z transmissions?
What is the torque specification for M10 screws on all transmission types for the reverse gear shaft to case?
What torque is required for the support for reverse gear shaft on 240/260 transmissions?
What is the torque specification for the bearing bracket on rear section of case for 240/260/265/280 transmissions?
How much torque should be applied to the mounting tabs for sealing cover on 280 transmissions?
What is the highest torque specification shown for bearing on countershaft?
qa_pairs.answer: 90 Nm using M10 screws for S 5 D 200 G/S 5 D 250 G transmissions.

qa_pairs.question: What torque is specified for the bearing on countershaft for S 5 D 310 Z transmissions?
What is the torque specification for the bearing on countershaft for 280 transmissions?
Which transmission case and cover component uses the lowest torque specification?
qa_pairs.answer: The bearing bracket on rear section of case and mounting tabs for sealing cover both use 10 Nm with M6 screws.
